theoretical_grounding: MIT 6.033 (Computer System Engineering: Network Buffering & The End-to-End Argument)

client_app.name: Client SDK / Egress Gateway
client_app.degradation_reason: Client experiencing high jitter and socket read timeouts.

edge_proxy.name: Enterprise WAF / Reverse Proxy (Envoy/Nginx)
edge_proxy.degradation_reason: Response body buffering enabled; chunked transfer frames aggregated into bursty TCP packets.

inference_worker.name: Inference GPU Shards & Paged Attention KV Cache

topology.invariant_violation: End-to-End Streaming Invariant: Proxy must deliver SSE byte chunks immediately without HTTP response-body buffering (X-Accel-Buffering: no).

remediation_steps.title: Audit Ingress & Reverse Proxy Response Buffering Headers
remediation_steps.verification_check: Verify that chunked transfer encoding is preserved end-to-end without buffering headers.

remediation_steps.title: Apply Dynamic Nginx / Envoy Streaming Configuration Patch
remediation_steps.verification_check: Run `nginx -t` to validate syntax prior to live reload.

remediation_steps.title: Gracefully Reload Reverse Proxy Configuration
remediation_steps.command: sudo nginx -s reload || curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:9901/drain_listeners
remediation_steps.expected_output: nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
remediation_steps.verification_check: Verify 0 dropped TCP connections in edge proxy active connection counter.

remediation_steps.title: Verify Chunk Cadence Recovery via Sentinel Streaming Probe
remediation_steps.command: sentinel diagnose --model gpt-4o --samples 15 || python -m post_agi_runbook_synthesizer.cli verify ./test_canary_probe.py
remediation_steps.verification_check: Assert TTFT < 600ms and inter-chunk jitter P95 < 30ms.
